label: transfers electrons via
definition: A relation that holds between an electron-transfer process and a diffusible redox carrier; asserts that the subject process moves reducing equivalents to a metabolic partner by means of the object carrier.
traits_addressed: covers 2 causal-graph edges in syntrophy (interspecies H2 / formate electron shuttling)
observations: mediated electron transfer; distinct from the direct donor->acceptor sense of METPO:2007403 (transfers electrons to) because the object is the diffusible carrier, not the terminal acceptor

label: imposes gradient of
definition: A relation that holds between an environmental condition or bioenergetic process and a chemical species; asserts that the subject establishes a transmembrane electrochemical gradient of the object species.
traits_addressed: covers 4 causal-graph edges (acidophily proton-gradient contexts: increases gradient of x3 + imposes gradient of x1)
observations: no RO/biolink relation captures "establishes an electrochemical gradient of"; central to chemiosmotic and acid-stress phenotypes

label: couples electron flow to
definition: A relation that holds between an electron-transport process and an energy-conserving process; asserts that the subject's electron flow is thermodynamically coupled to and drives the object process.
traits_addressed: covers 1 causal-graph edge (respiratory electron transport chain -> proton motive force)
observations: textbook chemiosmotic coupling relation; reusable across respiration / photosynthesis; no upstream relation expresses energetic coupling of electron flow to a downstream process

label: serves as electron donor and acceptor
definition: A relation that holds between a chemical species and a disproportionation process; asserts that the subject acts as both electron donor and electron acceptor within the object process.
traits_addressed: covers 1 causal-graph edge (inorganic sulfur intermediate -> disproportionation)
observations: captures disproportionation, where one species is simultaneously oxidized and reduced; not expressible by the single-direction redox predicates METPO:2007403 / METPO:2007405
